name: Permutation Fixed-Point Obfuscation
description: The standard 2-SAT OR clause is replaced by a sequential permutation process on three elements. The process conditionally applies transpositions (1,2) and (2,3) based on the truth values of the literals. The clause is satisfied if and only if the resulting permutation has at least one fixed point. This avoids any boolean logic or inequality syntax that LLMs use to pattern-match 2-SAT.
